trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn all 54 other trophies to unlock this platinum. Complete the story first, then mop up collectibles, activities, and missable trophies in a second run if needed. No specific action required beyond earning everything else.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission 'Gone Fishing.' This tutorial mission introduces the dual-protagonist system and basic controls. Unlocks automatically as you start the game — no way to miss it.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Complete all story missions in Chapter 1. This chapter establishes the Leonida setting and introduces key characters. Follow the primary mission markers on your map — it's impossible to miss if you progress the campaign.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish all Chapter 2 missions. The narrative expands into Vice City proper with new criminal enterprises. Simply follow the main mission path — this unlocks naturally through story progression.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3's storyline missions. The conflict deepens with rival gangs and cartels. Continue following the primary mission markers to finish this chapter.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4, the final chapter of the main story. This concludes the primary narrative arc before the finale. All story missions in this chapter must be completed.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final story mission of the game. This gold trophy marks the end of the main campaign. Simply play through to the conclusion of the narrative.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the 'Breakfast Run' mission, an early story mission introducing key mechanics. This is a mandatory story mission that cannot be missed — progress naturally through the campaign.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Finish 'The Cartel Heist' mission, a major story heist. Follow the mission markers and complete the objectives. Unlocks automatically as part of the main campaign.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the 'Child's Play' mission. This is a mandatory story mission that advances the plot. Simply follow the main quest line.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Finish the 'Headliners' mission. A story-critical mission that unlocks as you progress. No special requirements beyond completing it.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the 'VCIA Takedown' mission. This is a main story mission involving the VCIA. Follow the objectives to earn it naturally.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Finish 'Operation Savage Glory,' a major story mission. Progress the narrative to unlock and complete this mission.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion in the game. This requires finishing all story missions, finding all collectibles, completing all activities, and earning every other trophy. Save this for last.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Land 250 unique stunt jumps across the map. Stunt locations are marked on the map once discovered. Use a fast car or motorcycle, build speed, and hit the ramps cleanly. Track progress in the stats menu.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Participate in every distinct activity type at least once. This includes races, shooting ranges, drone races, fishing, arcade games, and more. Check your activity log to see which types you've tried.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Achieve gold medals on every shooting range challenge. Focus on accuracy and speed — headshots and quick target acquisition are key. Practice each range to learn target patterns before going for gold.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a drone race at each Top Fun location on the map. Drone races require precision flying through checkpoints. Learn the courses, use boosts strategically, and avoid obstacles. Each location has one race.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 distinct races across the game. This includes street races, off-road races, and boat races. You don't need to win every race — just 20 unique ones. Replay races if needed; only first-place finishes count.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Defeat Cal in a fishing competition. This is a specific story-related fishing challenge. Follow the on-screen prompts for casting, reeling, and fighting the fish. Timing the button presses is key.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Beat any one of the playable arcade cabinets found in bars, arcades, or safehouses. Insert a coin, play through to the end credits or high score screen. The cabinet in your first safehouse is the easiest access.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's final character mission. This unlocks after completing his earlier missions. Track his mission line on the map and complete each one until the final mission appears.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's final mission. Progress through his mission strand by doing his earlier tasks. The final mission will appear on the map when ready.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's final character mission. Complete his earlier missions first, then the finale will unlock. Check the map for his mission icons.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.guide: Finish every Stranger & Freak mission strand in the game. These side missions are marked with '?' icons on the map. Complete each character's full mission chain — some have multiple parts. Check your progress in the pause menu.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.guide: Complete the 'Supply Lines' story mission. This mission involves securing supply routes for your organization. Follow the mission markers and objectives — it unlocks naturally through story progression.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.guide: Complete the 'DJ Set' story mission. A unique mission involving music and nightlife elements. Progress the story to unlock and finish this mission.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Collect all Mental Health Awareness collectibles.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — Grab these as you go. Collect all mental health awareness items hidden across the map. If you progress past certain story points without them, they become permanently inaccessible. Use a helicopter for rooftop/remote spots. Check the collectibles menu for your count. Do not advance the main story past chapter lock points until you've cleared the current area.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.guide: Locate and collect all hunting-related collectibles (animal trophies, rare pelts, tracking markers). These are found in wilderness areas — Everglades, Grassrivers, and forests. Hunt the specific animals and interact with the trophies. Not missable — can be collected any time.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Find all 30 skateboard decks hidden throughout Vice City and the Keys. They glow faintly at night and are often on rooftops, behind buildings, or in alleyways. Use a helicopter for rooftop decks. Nighttime makes the glow much easier to see. Track progress in collectibles menu.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Collect all WAiN (Wireless Audio Information Network) radio collectibles. These are hidden in interiors — bars, clubs, offices, and safehouses. Enter every building you can access and listen for the audio cue. Some require story progress to unlock interiors. Not missable.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Finish the final remaining activity on your map. This unlocks naturally when you've completed all other activities — it's essentially a 'cleanup' trophy. Check your activity log for any incomplete entries.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.guide: Reach 5-star wanted level and survive for 10 real-time minutes. Use a tank (Rhino) or armored vehicle for best results. Find cover, avoid helicopters, and wait out the timer. The military base area spawns Rhinos reliably. Don't enter missions or interiors — it pauses the timer.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 20 stores without dying or losing the cops.
trophies.guide: Rob 20 convenience stores, liquor stores, or gas stations without dying or losing the cops. Start in a quiet area, hit stores quickly, and escape between each. Silenced weapons help. If you die or get caught, the count resets. Best done early when police response is lighter.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.description: Destroy 50 vehicles with a tow truck.
trophies.guide: Use a tow truck to destroy 50 vehicles by ramming or dropping them. The tow truck spawns at the impound lot and certain industrial areas. Hook a vehicle, drive fast, and detach to send it flying. Or lift and drop repeatedly. Counts across the whole playthrough.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.guide: Accumulate 100 headshot kills using any pistol. This tracks across the entire playthrough. Use free-aim mode for precision. Headshots on stunned or unaware enemies count. Grind in gang hideouts or during high wanted levels where enemies cluster.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.guide: Reach 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops without entering a vehicle. Use alleys, sewers, building interiors, and train tunnels to break line of sight. Stay out of sight until the wanted level clears. The subway system is ideal for this.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.description: Destroy a Rhino tank on foot.
trophies.guide: Destroy a military Rhino tank while on foot. Use RPG, grenades, sticky bombs, or the railgun. Tanks spawn at 5-star wanted level near military bases. Stay at range, use cover, and unload heavy weapons. The railgun makes this trivial if unlocked.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Complete a heist without triggering an alarm.
trophies.guide: Finish any heist from start to finish without triggering an alarm. Use suppressed weapons, melee takedowns, and stay out of camera view. If the alarm sounds, reload a save and retry. The earliest heist is the easiest for this. Patience is key — wait for patrol gaps.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Complete a heist with a take exceeding $1,000,000. Choose the maximum payout approach during planning — often the loud option yields more. Invest in good crew members (they take a cut but improve take). Complete all optional objectives. Replay if needed to optimize.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Recreate the Blitz Play heist setup.
trophies.guide: During a specific heist setup mission, arrange the crew and equipment to mirror the 'Blitz Play' from GTA V. This is a specific setup choice — select the crew and entry method that match the reference. The game will prompt you when the option is available.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Set foot in every named region/neighborhood across the map (Vice City, Keys, Everglades, Grassrivers, etc.). Drive, fly, or boat to each area — the region name appears on screen when you enter. A helicopter makes this fastest. Fog of war on the map shows unexplored zones.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.guide: Shoot or run over 100 pigeons (flying rats) scattered across the map. They perch on ledges, signs, and rooftops. Use a sniper rifle or drive a motorcycle through dense urban areas. They respawn, so you can farm a cluster. Check stats for count.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.guide: Start a new game from the main menu. This unlocks immediately upon beginning a fresh playthrough. Simply select 'New Game' — no other action needed.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash out of a vehicle showroom.
trophies.guide: Smash out of a vehicle showroom in a dramatic exit. Drive a vehicle through the showroom windows during a mission or free-roam. The trophy unlocks on impact. Any dealership works — the one in downtown Vice City is easiest to access.

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.guide: Play bowling at the Kolt & Associates alley in Vice City. Complete a full game (10 frames). The alley is marked on the map. You don't need a high score — just finish the game. Approach a lane and interact to start.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Experience a partnership moment with mass appeal. This occurs during a specific story beat with your co-protagonist. Progress the main campaign — it unlocks naturally at a key narrative moment. Cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make 500 tracked choices across playthroughs. Dialogue options, mission approach decisions, and branching paths all count. This accumulates naturally — a thorough single playthrough or two will hit the target. No need to grind specific choices.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Fail a mission or objective, then retry and succeed. Simply replay any failed mission to completion. This happens naturally during normal play — no need to intentionally fail.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: HIDDEN — Trigger a rare world event. Witness a strange or unexplained encounter: unusual lights in the Everglades at night, cryptid sightings, or glitch-like phenomena. These spawn randomly. Best odds: explore remote swamps and forests after 22:00 in-game time. Use a helicopter to cover ground fast. No fixed location — persistence is key.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock down a pedestrian with a melee attack while leaning out a moving vehicle window. Drive slowly in a convertible or windowed car, line up a pedestrian, lean out (hold aim), and press melee. Timing matters — practice in a quiet area.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 in Marked Bills via your criminal contacts. Marked Bills drop from heists, bank robberies, and major scores. Visit laundering contacts (unlocked mid-game) regularly to process the cash. This accumulates over the course of a playthrough.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a cumulative $100,000 at shops and services. Buy weapons, ammo, vehicles, clothing, properties, upgrades, and consumables. This happens naturally — just purchase what you need. Check the stats menu to track total spent.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties available for purchase. Garages unlock as you progress through the story and earn money. Open the property menu, check each garage listing, and buy them as they become affordable. Some require story progress to appear.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 unique vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. The app unlocks mid-story. Open it, select 'Register Vehicle,' and choose from owned or stolen vehicles. Each distinct model counts once. Steal variety — cars, bikes, boats all work.
